migrated: Blocking TCP connect/accept/accept4 execute on existing workers and release their execution slot on wait.
Original socket OFD, creating Files/credentials, absolute deadline and handshake phase survive target/cohort/owner handoff and numeric close/reuse.
Existing native edge observers and fabric transport/timer sources rearm before deciding retry; no new reactor or resource thread.
Related full-socket waits remain eligible with one runnable peer or all related tasks blocked, without requiring a GUI service.
Accepted seccomp decisions are retained; later SVCs use the current filter. Stop/signal/exit/exec preserve existing lifetime and restart semantics.
still_owner: Task/signal authority and structural VM/device ownership
Existing serial/traced execution fallback; no claim that the coordinator-removal goal is complete
constraints: No new unsafe, guest-memory barrier, quota, global network lock, service thread, message bus or polling loop.
Packet-stack timer semantics and normal native TCP byte paths remain unchanged.

linux_reference.identity: Exact ELF, kind and checked work match. Native Linux runs in the existing six-vCPU ARM64 local CI machine, not Trames.

apple_abi.method: 166 passing full-suite cases reused; all three final retained-socket tests pass, including the newly added handshake recovery.

apple_kernel.method: 256 full-suite passes reused; four final socket/cohort tests pass after the all-blocked admission change.

validation.unchanged_acceptance: CPU, memory and graphics acceptance reused. Only affected scopes and failed items rerun.

connection_stress.diagnosis: Native ephemeral TCP source ports exhausted by rapid sequential connection workloads; baseline and candidate both return EADDRNOTAVAIL.
connection_stress.outcome: Independent nonblocking session rerun passes. Native blocking reference is measured again after TIME_WAIT drains. No host limit or runtime behavior changed.

method: Four processes with checked fixed work. Three unprofiled counterbalanced Trames samples; longest-child loop median. Separate diagnostic profiles include startup, teardown and nonblocking retries, and do not represent CPU utilization. Native blocking macOS reference was measured independently after connection stress. No Firefox/whole-app speedup claim.
